strongest_angle: A November 2026 study published in Nature by a small CSIRO team confirms the iconic 2019 M87* black hole shadow using an independent interferometric observable, proving the ring structure is not an image-reconstruction artifact.

key_facts.fact: Published on 11 November 2026 in Nature, an independent group of four Australian researchers from CSIRO reanalysed the Event Horizon Telescope data using a new interferometric technique to confirm the shadow of black hole M87*.

The original 2019 image of black hole M87* was captured by the Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration, involving hundreds of scientists, which some researchers previously argued was an artifact of image-reconstruction techniques.
The new study led by researchers including Samuel Lai, Nithyanandan Thyagarajan, O. Ivy Wong, and Foivos Diakogiannis validates the iconic ring structure predicted by general relativity.
